title: Quietly Pungent Malaysian Chicken Satay
description: A light Malaysian dish featuring raspberry jam and a cheese-pull, made with a mortar-pestle-pound method and nut-free-friendly ingredients, this quietly pungent chicken satay is a unique twist on traditional satay.
instructions: Pound the coriander seeds and cumin seeds in a mortar until coarsely ground.
Add the garlic to the mortar and pound until well combined.
In a large bowl, whisk together the coconut milk, raspberry jam, and pounded spice mixture.
Add the chicken strips to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill or grill pan with vegetable oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the chicken for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, melt the grated cheddar cheese in a small saucepan over low heat.
Once the chicken is cooked, brush with the melted cheese and serve immediately.
